name: Thermal EOR (steam flood, SAGD, CSS)
principle: Steam lowers heavy-oil viscosity so it flows: steam flooding (commercial in California since the 1960s), cyclic steam stimulation and SAGD, where a steam injector sits 4 to 6 m above a horizontal producer. SAGD recovery is 60 to 80% in good reservoirs with steam-oil ratios of 2.8 to 4.0 in one Clearwater case.

process_steps.name: Produce hot oil and water by gravity

performance.basis: one section says up to 60%, another 70 to 80% in suitable reservoirs
